name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Mulgore, Taming the Beast brings a young tauren hunter to the last lesson under Yaw Sharpmane in Bloodhoof Village. A taming rod lets the hunter bond with a wild swoop and prove mastery of the air. Completing the trial grants lasting knowledge to tame, call, and dismiss a companion, with the Earthmother's trust.

sections.title: Mastery of the Sky
sections.body: After you subdue predators on Mulgore's plains, Yaw Sharpmane turns your attention to the open sky. A swoop is a fierce bird of prey with a sharp beak, sweeping dives, and an intimidating air. Its talons test your reflexes and calm as you use the enchanted rod to bring its instincts into accord with your own.

sections.title: The Earthmother's Gift
sections.body: For the tauren, hunting and companionship with beasts are spiritual pursuits, not mere subjugation. Mastering creatures of earth and sky shows the balance and respect needed to walk the plains without disturbing nature. Yaw Sharpmane takes back his temporary taming rod and teaches you lasting techniques to call, dismiss, and permanently tame a companion of your choosing.

faq.q: Why do I have to tame a swoop for the final trial?
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane tests you against creatures of the sky in this final trial. Swoops strike swiftly and sharply, and their imposing presence tests whether a hunter can handle both air and ground predators before earning independence.

faq.q: Do I keep the swoop I tame during this quest?
faq.answer: No. You tame the swoop only temporarily with Yaw Sharpmane's rod during your training. Afterward, you can tame any wild beast you wish to keep permanently.

faq.q: Who gives this quest and where are they located?
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane, the hunter trainer in Bloodhoof Village in central Mulgore, gives you the third and final step of your initial beast-taming trials.

faq.q: What happens after I return the taming rod?
faq.answer: Yaw Sharpmane teaches you the inherent abilities to tame, call, and dismiss beasts on your own. He also directs you to Thunder Bluff to learn how to train and care for your chosen companion.

faq.q: Where can I find wild swoops in Mulgore?
faq.answer: Wild swoops roam Mulgore's open grasslands and mesa edges, often circling the plains just outside Bloodhoof Village.

faq.q: Why is pet taming considered a rite of passage for tauren?
faq.answer: Tauren see beasts as fellow children of the Earthmother, not tools. Bonding with a companion takes patience, mutual respect, and spiritual balance, not force alone.

angles.text: As a hunter, you complete the foundational training chain and gain the ability to tame beasts permanently, marking your passage from apprentice to self-reliant scout of the wilds.
As a Shu'halo, bonding with a wild beast is spiritual communion blessed by the Earthmother, with deep cultural meaning across Mulgore's plains.
